en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view taken from a wooded path on a hillside, with birch trees framing an open field and a town in the distance. The town shows a prominent church spire, factory chimneys, and clustered buildings against low rolling hills. Two figures in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the left side of the path. At the upper right, there is red printed text identifying the location.
